fact: Under the DRIVE project, an NDVI satellite index livestock insurance covered 16,829 pastoralists in Garissa, Wajir, Tana River and Samburu for 1 October 2022 to 30 September 2023, with the second payout calculated for January-February 2023.
title: October to December 2022 Season Summary Report - Phase 2, DRIVE Index Based Livestock Insurance (Kenya)
